cases.title: Brake pads

headline.label: Change in parts billed
headline.basis: ISZE to Isuzu Truck UK; selected brake-pad subgroup

cases.summary: Unit purchasing fell faster than billed value. Start with a distributor review, not a claim about dealer losses.

chart.title: Parts billed to Isuzu Truck UK
chart.caption: Full calendar years; same selected subgroup. Not sales to end customers.

facts: 4,562 units in 2024 and 3,402 in 2025, on the selected product-mix scope.
The attached dealer summary has 64 named dealers, in 2025 only. It cannot explain a dealer year-on-year decline.
Relevant fleet by dealer and validated brake-pad applicability are not supplied. No dealer service-demand rate is calculated.
cases.interpretation: The selected subgroup has a measured purchasing decline. A lower share of brake pads in a dealer's own 2025 parts purchases would be a mix signal, not proof of lost maintenance business.
cases.limitation: No dealer-year comparison, causal price effect or unusually low dealer performance is established. A validated part mapping is still needed before a dealer-mix signal is scored.
cases.next_action: Review the distributor decline. Then compare each dealer's brake-pad share of its own 2025 purchases with the ITUK network share, using one validated part set and one valuation basis.
checks: Confirm the selected brake-pad membership before any product-specific intervention.
Keep 2025 dealer snapshots separate from distributor 2024-2025 change.
Treat mix differences as questions, not service-demand gaps.

references.method: Change = 2025 total_eur minus 2024 total_eur. Percentage change = (2025 / 2024 - 1) x 100.
Count unique dealer names; inspect available calendar years.

headline.label: Parts billed in the selected 2025 scope

cases.summary: BVP enters the selected scope in 2025. Separate the mix change from any pricing conclusion.

chart.caption: ISZE to IUK; full calendar years. BVP = Best Value Parts. No concession-scope values are mixed into these bars.

facts: Genuine parts billed rise within the selected scope; BVP adds a separate new contribution. BVP accounts for 53.1% of the increase in billed value.
The selected extract contains 4,033 units in 2024 and 6,012 in 2025.
Market fleet context: 47,783 vehicles in the 2025 spend-per-truck extract. This is not a dealer fleet denominator.
cases.interpretation: No immediate price action is indicated by this purchasing evidence alone. The BVP entry is part of the observed growth; it is not evidence of a price-response relationship.
cases.limitation: The requested concession file is absent. The separate concession-scope total and the falling-concession claim are not used here. No competitor retail price is compared with a dealer reference price.
cases.next_action: Review the Genuine/BVP change on this one scope. Obtain the concession source and reconcile its membership before adding any concession trend or price recommendation.
checks: Keep Genuine and BVP visible on the same scope.
Do not blend the product-mix and concession totals.
Any later competitor comparison needs matched tax, channel, pack and applicability.

references.method: Total = original_eur + value_parts_eur. BVP contribution to growth = change in BVP euro / change in total euro. Full-year comparison only.
